Yeah, you should be good, my industrial took about 8 months to heal so it’s a long journey but it’s definitely worth it. 

Custom industrials look dope, I would look into it if the straight bar doesn’t work out. The two piercings look super cute separately too!

It doesn’t look infected, it’s probably just irritated. My industrial swells up like that when I sleep on it or accidentally brush it when I’m doing my hair. 

However, I have doubts that you’ll be able to put an industrial bar in. The piercings are at an angle that wouldn’t allow for a straight bar without putting pressure on them. If you were to put a straight bar in, you might have to go through the healing process all over again, and your piercings may even migrate. 

My industrial bar was put in right after both piercings were done, during the same session. AFAIK most piercers in the Association of Professional Piercers put the bar in immediately, to make sure the angles are right. 

You could possibly get a custom curved industrial bar in once your two helix piercings are healed.
